close_reason: Updated five stub arms to note silent null return and need for implementation or error before production
description: Five arms of apply_header_form (AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, AsURLs) each carry the comment 'RFC 8621 §4.1.2 structured form not yet implemented; returns null.' A client at 2am seeing null where structured address data was expected will have no actionable error message. More importantly, the validate_header_form function explicitly ACCEPTS these forms as valid (it only rejects cross-type mismatches), so a client requesting asAddresses for a From header receives null without any error — a silent data loss. The comments should note the silent-null-return consequence so an implementor knows this needs a future error or implementation, not just 'returns null'.
title: email.rs: apply_header_form stubs return null with no indication of when they will be implemented
